    SPORTS

    Since 2017, we have created numerous games and experiences for sport clubs and venues around the world.

    ​

    Location-based multiplayer
    games, AR challenges, arena-based activities and much more.

    ​

    We always leverage the newest technologies, infusing the real world with virtual experiences.

    ​

    Combined with the latest gaming trends, clubs and venues better appeal and communicate with their young fans.

    ​

    Our projects include clubs and venues from the following disciplines:

    Basketball

    Football (Soccer)

    Baseball

    Golf

    Sailing

    Racing

    Digital Racing

    Community

    Producing software doesn't come without a carbon footprint.

    We travel to meet people, purchase electronic equipment,
    print contracts in three copies and so on...

    In addition to daily actions (Refuse-Reduce-Reuse-Repurpose-Recycle-Recover),

    we actively donate toward different causes, such as wildlife protection, reforestation and offsetting our flights (of course we take the train when possible).
